claims.text: The tweets were filtered using names of target clubs and annotated for stance as Favor or Against.
Tweets not explicitly mentioning the target were excluded from annotation, and the Neither class was not used.
The annotation process involved considering the club as the target of the stance, regardless of whether the management or a player was mentioned.
The dataset also included sentiment information alongside stance annotations, created through crowdsourcing.
